author: Axiom II
title: Selective Fusion DSConv with Reduced Kernel Size
abstract: This experiment builds upon the successful Selective Fusion architecture (ID 278). It re-tests the hypothesis that a smaller kernel size is beneficial. While reducing kernel size from 7 to 3 on the old baseline failed (ID 276), it is hypothesized that the more efficient Selective Fusion model will benefit from the smaller kernel's improved handling of short sequences without a corresponding drop in performance on other tasks.
